decision: Experimental: fresh random I/O improves, but aged reads remain 5.7% below production and aged random-write request throughput remains 21.5% below production. Sync variability must not mask request cost. No production default or format changes.
profile_encoding: Zero-valued counter fields and all-zero events are omitted; phase/role arrays preserve their original order.

python.skip_reason: Format 1004 has no production v1 migration

limitations: Hardware/software perf events denied at perf_event_paranoid=4; no global kernel setting changed.
Scoped timers include instrumentation overhead; self_ns excludes nested recorded scopes, not all timer bookkeeping.
Allocation counts cover C++ new/delete only. No per-read readlink or FD classification is used.

host.scope: Host aggregate; includes the owned benchmark and other machine activity. No attribution to other jobs.
